maya: Quick ask 1: land a terse 'Optimize heuristics' doc + tiny sample-corpus + a smoke bench. One PR. Who picks this up?

oliver: I can do the corpus CSV. Any token distribution targets?

maya: Mix: ~55% short (<64), ~35% mid (64-512), ~10% long (512-1200). Add 4 embedding rows and 2 multi-turn chats.

keiko: I'll draft the playbook. Sections: batching heuristic, KV prefetch guidance, quant-profile tips, and smoke-check expectations.

sam: I'll add a minimal bench (bench.py --smoke) and an SDK snippet. Snippet example: `await client.generate({model: "redwood-opt-3b-quant", input: p, batch_size: 8, kv_prefetch: true})`. Note: use `stream: false` for smoke.

oliver: Posted CSV gist: https://gist.github.com/oliver/opt-sample-2 (WIP). I'll include Apache-2.0 in README.

maya: Put files in one PR: docs/optplaybook/heuristics.md, docs/optplaybook/examples/sample-corpus.csv, examples/bench/bench.py. Tag reviewers.

docs-bot: New PR opened by oliver: #6420 "optkit: heuristics playbook + sample corpus + smoke bench". CI: running.

sam: CI smoke failed on linux-quant runner (latency threshold too tight). Relaxed threshold and added runner buckets.

docs-bot: CI all checks passed. PR #6420 merged by maya.

maya: Post-merge: add link from optimize landing and post a short announcement in #eng-ml. I'll handle landing link. Can someone announce?

keiko: I'll post announcement and file a monthly bench ticket.

maya: Thanks everyone, closing thread.
